programme.title: Wrath of Man
programme.desc: (2021) Jason Statham reunites with director Guy Ritchie to give it both barrels as a mysterious hardman working for a money truck firm that keeps getting hit. Is he an inside man?

programme.title: Earth Mama
programme.desc: (2023) Tia Nomore stars in BAFTA-winning Savanah Leaf's deeply affecting portrait of a pregnant single mum in recovery who's trying to prove to an unfeeling system that she's a good mum.

programme.title: Carla's Song
programme.desc: (1996) Ken Loach's film sees Glaswegian bus driver Robert Carlyle get a political education when he accompanies Nicaraguan refugee Oyanka Cabezas back to her home country. Strong language.

programme.title: Fixed Bayonets!
programme.desc: (1951) Korean War drama about the stress of battle. Officers drop one by one as a US platoon fights a rearguard action, leaving one unwilling man (Richard Basehart) to take their place.

programme.title: The Rare Breed
programme.desc: (1966) Western with Maureen O'Hara and James Stewart. With the help of a drifter, a widow strives to fulfil her husband's last wish to introduce rare cattle to the perilous American west.

programme.title: The Frogmen
programme.desc: (1951) Second World War thriller. Richard Widmark, Dana Andrews and Robert Wagner star as divers with a special underwater demolition team taking the war to the Japanese in the Pacific.

programme.title: Secret Headquarters
programme.desc: (2022) Family comedy with Owen Wilson. A young lad discovers that his slacker dad is a superhero. And before he's got used to the idea, he must foil a villain's plot to bring his dad down.

programme.title: The Martian
programme.desc: (2015) Matt Damon stars in Ridley Scott's drama about an astronaut who accidentally gets left behind on Mars. Oops. How will he survive and how on earth can he get home?

programme.title: The First Omen
programme.desc: (2024) Ever wondered how Damian - aka son of Satan - from the seminal 1976 horror The Omen came to be spawned? Well, wonder no more - this dark prequel with Nell Tiger Free tells the tale.

programme.title: Alita: Battle Angel
programme.desc: (2019) Visually stunning part-animated action film based on a popular manga. A deadly cyborg who's been brought back to life by a mourning scientist sets out to discover her true identity.

programme.title: The Second Act
programme.desc: (2024) Quentin Dupieux's film-industry satire about a bunch of anxious actors stuck in a formulaic movie about relationship troubles, starring Louis Garrel, Raphaël Quenard and Léa Seydoux.

programme.title: Hail the Conquering Hero
programme.desc: (1944) Satirical wartime comedy starring Eddie Bracken as a man who becomes a celebrated war hero despite having been medically discharged from the marines after only a few weeks.

programme.title: The Art of Racing in the Rain
programme.desc: (2019) Touching comedy-drama. An ageing golden retriever (voiced by Kevin Costner) tells the story of his life with his best pal, a budding Formula 1 driver.

programme.title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
programme.desc: (1957) David Lean's Oscar-winning fact-based Second World War classic stars Alec Guinness as the driven commander of a group of POWs building a rail bridge for the Japanese.

programme.title: Battleship
programme.desc: (2012) Sci-fi action-adventure starring Taylor Kitsch, Liam Neeson and Rihanna. When aliens land spacecraft in the Pacific Ocean, only the US and Japanese navies can save Earth.

programme.title: American Star
programme.desc: (2024) Ian McShane stars as an ageing hitman dispatched to an island paradise to dispatch a target. Will he find or lose himself, in Gonzalo López-Gallego's tensely reserved thriller?

programme.title: Lisa Frankenstein
programme.desc: (2024) Zelda Williams directs Diablo Cody's Frankenstein/Heathers adjacent 'coming-of-rage' comedy chiller about a teenage outcast whose dead crush comes back to life, with Kathryn Newton.

programme.title: Saint Maud
programme.desc: (2019) Psychological horror. After failing to save a life, a nurse transforms her life and vows to save the godless soul of a terminally-ill atheist woman from an eternity with Satan.

programme.desc: (1948) Historical adventure. A man (Louis Hayward) returns from the Wars of the Roses to learn from his uncle that a family friend has killed his father. But is everything as it seems?

programme.title: Crash Dive

programme.title: Flamin' Hot
